signal: VitalEdge launched VitalityAI, an agentic AI suite for heavy equipment dealers, at its Evolve 2026 conference and won a Gold TITAN Business Award

email.body1:
Jonathan, saw VitalEdge launch VitalityAI at Evolve 2026 and take Gold at the TITAN Business Awards.

A platform launch like that opens conversations across your whole dealer base, usually more accounts in-market than the team can cover before the window closes. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for VitalEdge off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jonathan, quick follow-up for VitalEdge.

An AI launch spikes interest, but most teams can't tell how many of those dealers they're actually touching, so the surge converts at a fraction of its potential. The gap shows up after the conference buzz fades.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings VitalEdge needs to turn VitalityAI momentum into target this quarter.
email.body3:
Jonathan, last bit of proof for VitalEdge.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how VitalEdge's reply rate likely compares to peer dealer-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jonathan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling dealer pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Rolling out a new AI suite is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a dealer-tech motion? I'll tailor it to VitalEdge either way.
